planner_profile.yaml:
fsm:
  click_goal_en: true
  click_goal_topic: /zav/goal_pose
  click_height: 1.5
  click_yaw_en: false
  replan_rate: 1.0
  cmd_topic: /zav_super/internal_unused_pos_cmd
  mpc_cmd_topic: /zav_super/internal_unused_mpc_cmd
  timer_en: false
super_planner:
  backup_traj_en: true
  detailed_log_en: false
  visualization_en: true
  use_fov_cut: false
  print_log: true
  visual_process: false
  frontend_in_known_free: false
  goal_yaw_en: false
  goal_vel_en: false
  corridor_bound_dis: 3.0
  corridor_line_max_length: 1.2
  safe_corridor_line_max_length: 5.0
  iris_iter_num: 2
  obs_skip_num: 2
  replan_forward_dt: 0.35
  planning_horizon: 15.0
  sensing_horizon: -1
  receding_dis: 1.0
  robot_r: 0.43
  yaw_dot_max: 3.0
  yaw_mode: 1
  mpc_horizon: 15
  frontend_body_clearance: true
traj_opt:
  switch:
    save_log_en: false
    print_optimizer_log: false
  boundary:
    max_vel: 1.0
    max_acc: 1.0
    max_jerk: 6.0
    max_omg: 1.5
    max_acc_thr: 20.0
    min_acc_thr: 6.0
    penna_margin: 0.05
  exp_traj:
    pos_constraint_type: 1
    energy_cost_type: 4
    block_energy_cost: false
    opt_accuracy: 5.0e-06
    scale_factor: 1.0
    integral_reso: 15
